thread:
Sarah: Flagging a spike in onboarding latency that affected provisioning and delayed activation emails for ~7 accounts between 13:05-13:40 UTC. Some are renewal-risk. Need a customer note and a plan for high-touch outreach.
Priya: Investigating. Early telemetry points to a throttling rule applied to the mailer service during a deploy. Were rolling back that change for onboarding flows only.
Diego: Drafting the outbound. Keep it concise: apology, what were doing, immediate remediation steps we will take (manual activation + re-run onboarding), optional credit offer, and invite to office hours.
Noah: Ops has queued the rollback for the mailer config. ETA 18m to validate deliveries. Also increasing retry window for pending activation tasks.
Eve (Legal): Use cautious language: "may have experienced delays"; avoid commitments on credits publicly - say "we will evaluate account-level credits". Also include a clear contact path for high-touch customers.
Priya: Draft snippet:```Hi Were reaching out about onboarding delays you may have experienced today. Our team identified a throttling configuration change that impacted activation emails and provisioning for a subset of accounts. Weve rolled back the change for onboarding flows and are prioritizing manual activation and re-runs for affected accounts. If you notice an incomplete activation or missing emails reply to this thread or contact your CS rep and well re-run onboarding for you. Were evaluating account-level credits and will follow up with an RCA.   
```
Diego: Will add an in-product banner for the impacted accounts and prepare a high-touch email template for the three renewal-risk tenants offering live troubleshoot + proposed credit.
Noah: Rollback completed at 13:25 UTC; delivery retries are processing. Metrics show activation delivery back to baseline by 13:38 UTC. Two tenants still require manual re-run due to large batch sizes.
Priya: Noted. Tagging those two for 1:1 outreach and scheduling a 30-min office hours at 15:00 UTC. Also preparing a short survey to capture whether onboarding issues impacted conversion intent.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-677 created, severity P3.
Sarah: Approve sending the public note. Diego, send high-touch templates to renewals list and include suggested credit amounts for approval. Keep execs in loop.
Diego: Final copy posted to comms folder. Sending now after Sarah sign-off.
Sarah: Signed off. After RCA, update account health scores and add notes to the renewal tracker. :thumbsup:
